# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

`workflows/rainy.yml` is the only workflow. On pushes to `main`, pull requests and manual dispatch it runs two jobs. `source` runs on `ubuntu-24.04` and `windows-2022` with Node 24: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm exec vitest run`, `pnpm run test:node` and `pnpm run build`. `host` runs `cargo test --locked -p rainy-host -p rainy-protocol` in `native/` on `ubuntu-24.04`, because the Host also runs in WSL and on SSH servers; the interface crates need Windows and are not built in CI. Installers are built and signed on a Windows workstation with `scripts/package.ps1` ([desktop guide](../docs/desktop.md)); no workflow publishes releases.
